title: SWF: End-to-end compile and parse round-trip
description: End-to-end test: build a moderately complex FlashDocument (2 scenes, 3 layers each, motion tween, a symbol instance, a shape, frame labels, background color, frame rate 24fps), export to SWF, parse the tag stream, verify: file header magic, correct version byte (8), frameRate, SetBackgroundColor matches, at least one DefineShape and PlaceObject2, at least one ShowFrame, correct End tag. Tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/e2e-compile.test.ts.
